svg.title: Updated every day: my terminal running neofetch
svg.desc: Updated 15 Oct 2026. The assistant, measured 15 Oct 2026: recall at 10 of 0.99 with hybrid search and reranking, 77 of 86 answer checks passed, 8 of 10 prompt injections resisted, first word after 11.8 seconds at the median. Latest commits: 15 Oct, til: TIL: I worked on the valid anagram problem by building a letter … (#11); 15 Oct, til: TIL: I solved the majority element problem by counting each numb… (#10); 15 Oct, nyc-taxis: Add the MIT license and the author footer (#1); 15 Oct, delivery-time: Add the MIT license and the author footer (#1). Assistant deployed 15 Oct, assistant CI passing, portfolio online. Today I learned (15 Oct 2026): I worked on the valid anagram problem by building a letter count dictionary for each string and returning `box==box2`, since two dictionaries compare equal when they hold the same keys with the same counts.
